name: Qatar

flag.description: A maroon field with a white vertical band at the hoist, separated by a serrated edge of nine white points; the flag is unusually elongated, with proportions of 11:28.
flag.symbolism: The nine points are said to mark Qatar as the ninth member of the reconciled emirates of the Gulf after a 1916 treaty; maroon recalls blood shed in conflicts and white peace.

hook: Qatar is the extra-long maroon flag with nine white zigzag points; Bahrain's is bright red, shorter and has five.
trivia: It is the only national flag whose width is more than twice its height.
The maroon is often said to come from red dyes that darkened in the desert sun.
